description: [Spend policy: agent payment rules check, plus an audit record] Check one proposed payment against the buyer's rules (per-tx limit, rolling cap with spent-so-far, categories, allow/deny lists, hours+timezone, assets/chains, human-approval threshold). Returns allow / deny / needs_approval, which rules fired, and an audit record (decisionReceipt). Signing is OFF today, so the record is unsigned; see GET /.well-known/gw8-receipt-key. Stateless, deterministic; not custody; does not move money. $0.02. Paid: $0.02 USDC on Base, paid in-band via x402 MCP (@x402/mcp; _meta "x402/payment"). Also at POST https://micro-saas-agent.onrender.com/api/spend/check.

pass.description: Optional GW8 day pass token (from buy_day_pass / POST /api/pass/day); skips per-call payment

policy.description: currency, perTxLimit, rollingCap {limit, spentSoFar, windowHours}, allowedCategories, blockedCategories, allowList, denyList, onUnlisted (deny|needs_approval), allowedHours {start, end, timezone, days}, allowedAssets, allowedChains, requireApprovalAbove
